summary: Iteration 4 tests for public form label changes and admin manual booking modal all passed. Backend: 5/5 pytest (test_admin_manual_booking.py) covering maps_link persistence, empty payment_proof_path, admin-selected status persisting (confirmed/completed), weekday allowed for historic bookings, and server-side transport recalculation. UI: verified public form new labels/placeholders (Nama Pasangan Pria & Wanita, Tanggal berapa acaranya?, Acaranya jam berapa kak?, Tulis link Google Mapsnya ya kak). Admin dashboard admin-add-booking-button opens modal; validation blocks empty save; DP custom <Rp 50.000 rejected; Basic 19 km save flow shows Rp 45.000 transport & Rp 195.000 total; booking appears in list with 19 km, Rp 45.000 transport, and booking-maps-link-<id> as target=_blank pointing to entered URL. Mobile 390 px: no horizontal overflow on modal or public form; typing works.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminBookingModal trusts client-supplied `status` (confirmed/pending/completed) and Booking model has no whitelist enum; not a security risk but consider Literal[...] for status.

Backend still recalculates transport/total but trusts client `payment_amount` for lunas even though total is recalculated server-side; possible mismatch if UI ever forges. Non-blocking (iteration 3 comment).
Public BookingForm still requires bukti transfer; admin modal correctly makes it optional per requirement.
seed_data_creation: Created ~7 TEST_-prefixed bookings during backend + UI runs; all deleted via admin API cleanup after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest backend/tests/test_admin_manual_booking.py -o addopts= -v (pytest.ini uses xdist -n auto but this single file runs fine). Public booking form lives at '/' (not '/booking'); scroll not required if using data-testid='booking-form'. AdminBookingModal opens via admin-add-booking-button on bookings tab of AdminDashboard.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All new features (labels, maps_link input, admin manual booking modal with status field, weekday allowed on backend, mobile responsiveness) validated end-to-end.
